title: Shoggoth wall art — round 07: body & pose (composition only)
notes: PICK THE BODY + POSE to build. Silhouettes only: surface, hands, teeth, eyes come after. G3a vs G3b = vertical vs horizontal maw. ··· Why this round: r05/r06 had no defined organism (your notes). These are built as one creature — head set into a trunk, limbs rooted along it, shelves at limb ends, 300 mm clear above each shelf. Left of each card: 3-value silhouette (mask white, maw black, body dark). Right: the 3D massing, smooth on purpose. ALSO, in your issue notes: (1) keep or release r05's shelf placement and radial layout? (we already keep: side-profile depth, smiley + maw, 300 mm plant clearance); (2) the 3x3 ft size question from r06 is withdrawn — size wasn't the real limit, our authoring method was.

cards.title: G1a — c01-style: tall trunk, arms to three shelves
cards.rationale: Closest to c01: head set into the top of a tall trunk, maw in the chest, shelves high-left / mid-right / low-left (your r05 arrangement), three tentacles below.

cards.title: G1b — same body, head offset, trunk leaning
cards.rationale: G1a's anatomy with more asymmetry: head pushed left, trunk leaning, shelves re-staggered (high-right, mid-left, low-right).

cards.title: G2a — diagonal emergence, head upper right
cards.rationale: The creature climbs the wall on a diagonal; a whip rises over the head. Big empty wall wedges. (r05's diagonal had no body — this one does.)

cards.title: G3a — low crouch, horns, VERTICAL maw
cards.rationale: Hunched, wide trunk, two horn-limbs over the head, eight limbs. Maw vertical like c01.

cards.title: G3b — low crouch, horns, HORIZONTAL maw
cards.rationale: Same as G3a with the maw turned horizontal — vote this pair to settle maw orientation.

cards.title: G4a — sinuous ribbon (closest to your sketch)
cards.rationale: S-curved ribbon body, head upper left, from your original sketch. Our composition gate scores it weakest (bean-shaped body, crowded lower half) — shown so your sketch direction gets a fair vote.

cards.title: c01 — the target you loved, and its traced silhouette
cards.rationale: Reference for judging the poses: head in a tall trunk, six limbs, three shelves at limb ends, open wall between limbs. Vote like if it should stay the north star.
